synopsis: MOCS is a construction dataset identified as dating to 2021, containing 41,668 images from 174 construction sites and covering 13 object classes [f5846, f12811]. Chapter 13 repeats the 41,668-image count, citing a September 2026 preprint; this is a reporting date rather than an explicitly different dataset date [f10826]. The glossary describes MOCS, alongside SODA, as image-only data captured from fixed or aerial viewpoints rather than a machine-mounted multi-sensor rig, a scope limitation planners should retain when considering its use [f12813].
